name: Meta El Paso SPV (Project Sopaipilla Holdings)
monetization: Special-purpose venture that develops and owns Meta's 1GW El Paso, TX data-center campus; ~80% owned by funds managed by BlackRock (GIP and HPS), 20% by Meta; income is Meta's lease payments as sole occupant.
description_md: Announced July 2026 as a strategic venture between Meta and BlackRock to develop an approximately $14B, 1GW data-center campus in El Paso, Texas (completion expected 2028, Meta sole occupant). Funded in part with a $12.5B bond sold July 27, 2026 at a 7.53% yield — one of the widest spreads for an A-or-better rated bond in three years, and visibly costlier than the Hyperion JV's 6.58% notes nine months earlier. The structure keeps the campus off Meta's balance sheet.

observations.notes: Notes priced Jul 27, 2026 at 7.53% yield, ~287.5bp over 10-year Treasuries.
~$14B total development cost for the 1GW campus; completion expected 2028.
